productTasks.build: "Share Trip" export — Trip card → clean branded image, one tap
productTasks.why: Unlocks real users generating shareable content before you've posted a single video
Second-highest leverage, still simple to build
Higher effort, can ship after content is already running

contentCalendar.format: Second Garagey post — your proven format gets 2x/week
Driving tip w/ app utility woven in

rolloutPlan.title: Launch
rolloutPlan.description: Launch content calendar as above. Ship "Share Trip" export mid-week if possible. Log every post per the daily execution checklist.

rolloutPlan.title: Ship rank-up card
rolloutPlan.description: Continue calendar. Ship shareable rank-up card. Review Week 1 log — which non-Garagey pillar got the most organic "what app is that" pickup (not just views)? Start weighting Week 3 toward that.

rolloutPlan.title: Adjust weighting
rolloutPlan.description: Adjust calendar weighting based on Week 2 data — e.g. if POV Daily is outperforming Fake Scripted POV, swap Sunday's slot for a second POV Daily post. Keep Garagey at 2x/week regardless unless a pillar clearly overtakes it.

rolloutPlan.title: Wrapped groundwork + full review
rolloutPlan.description: Ship "Driveverse Wrapped" recap groundwork (even a simple version). Full review: which pillars are working, which burner-seeded posts saw genuine organic pickup vs needed heavy seeding, and whether download numbers correlate with any specific pillar or posting time.

checklistSteps.title: T+0 (post time) — Publish
checklistSteps.description: Publish video. No app name in caption, on-screen text, or voiceover. App-screen moment is 3–5 seconds, mid-action, most-viral-feature-first (rotate: live map w/ nearby drivers → trip/route card → quest/XP notification).

checklistSteps.title: T+30–60 min — Seed comments
checklistSteps.description: From 3–4 burner accounts, comment "Driveverse?" — stagger them (don't post all four in the same minute; space by 5–15 min so it doesn't look scripted).

checklistSteps.title: T+45–90 min — Confirm
checklistSteps.description: Reply from the main content account to each burner comment, confirming the name.

checklistSteps.title: T+2–4 hrs — Check organic pickup
checklistSteps.description: Check if real accounts have started asking the same question organically — if yes, stop seeding further on that post, it's self-sustaining. If no organic pickup by hour 4, note it and move on rather than over-seeding.

checklistSteps.title: End of day — Log
checklistSteps.description: Log the post (pillar, feature shown, seed timing, whether organic pickup happened) — this is what lets you find your second working pillar after a few weeks instead of guessing.
